## Overview

This document contains a list of maintainers in this repo. See [RESPONSIBILITIES.md](https://github.com/pylapp/miso-ios/blob/develop/.github/RESPONSIBILITIES.md#maintainer-responsibilities) that explains what the role of maintainer means, what maintainers do in this repository, and how they should be doing it. If you're interested in contributing, and becoming a maintainer, see [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/pylapp/miso-ios/blob/develop/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
